exercises.title: integer out of range: multiply in bigint
exercises.problemHtml:
The report SELECT id, qty * unit_cents AS total_cents FROM big_sale crashes with ERROR: integer out of range: int × int is computed as int (max 2 147 483 647). Return id, total_cents for every row, ordered by id, without changing the table.

big_sale (id int PK, qty int, unit_cents int) — 4 rows; row 3 is 50 000 × 990 000 cents

Requirements

  • Cast one operand to bigint before multiplying.
  • Columns id, total_cents.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Báo cáo SELECT id, qty * unit_cents AS total_cents FROM big_sale sập với ERROR: integer out of range: int × int được tính bằng int (tối đa 2 147 483 647). Trả về id, total_cents cho mọi dòng, sắp theo id, không sửa bảng.

big_sale (id int PK, qty int, unit_cents int) — 4 dòng; dòng 3 là 50 000 × 990 000 xu

Yêu cầu

  • Ép một toán hạng sang bigint trước khi nhân.
  • Cột id, total_cents.

FROM big_sale
ORDER BY id;

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: PostgreSQL never silently wraps around: an int result above 2 147 483 647 is an error (SQLSTATE 22003). Promoting one side to bigint makes the whole product bigint.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: PostgreSQL không bao giờ lặng lẽ quay vòng: kết quả int vượt 2 147 483 647 là lỗi (SQLSTATE 22003). Nâng một vế lên bigint thì cả tích là bigint.

exercises.title: Money in float vs numeric
exercises.problemHtml:
Ten customers each tipped 0.10. Return one row: total (the sum) and is_one (whether the total equals exactly 1.00). The answer must be 1.00 | true — use the column that stores money correctly.

tip (id, amount_f double precision, amount_n numeric(12,2)) — ten tips of 0.10

Requirements

  • One SELECT with sum(…); columns total, is_one.
  • Never compare money stored as float for equality.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Mười khách mỗi người tip 0.10. Trả về một dòng: total (tổng) và is_one (tổng có đúng bằng 1.00 không). Đáp án phải là 1.00 | true — dùng cột lưu tiền đúng cách.

tip (id, amount_f double precision, amount_n numeric(12,2)) — mười khoản 0.10

Yêu cầu

  • Một câu SELECT với sum(…); cột total, is_one.
  • Đừng bao giờ so bằng tiền lưu kiểu float.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: 0.1 has no exact binary representation, so ten float additions miss 1 by about 10−16. numeric stores decimal digits and adds them exactly — the only right type for money.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: 0.1 không biểu diễn chính xác được ở hệ nhị phân, nên mười phép cộng float lệch 1 khoảng 10−16. numeric lưu chữ số thập phân và cộng chính xác — kiểu duy nhất đúng cho tiền.

exercises.title: Import legacy ids into an identity column
exercises.problemHtml:
Two tickets from the old system must keep their ids: 100 "Projector broken" and 101 "No toner". Insert them with those ids, then make sure the next ticket created normally gets id 102 (not 3, and not a collision later).

ticket (id int GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PK, title) — ids 1, 2 already used

Requirements

  • INSERT … OVERRIDING SYSTEM VALUE VALUES (100, …), (101, …) — a GENERATED ALWAYS column refuses explicit ids otherwise.
  • Move the identity sequence: SELECT setval(pg_get_serial_sequence('ticket', 'id'), …) computed from the table, not a hard-coded 101.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Hai phiếu từ hệ cũ phải giữ id: 100 "Projector broken" và 101 "No toner". Chèn chúng với đúng id đó, rồi bảo đảm phiếu kế tiếp tạo bình thường nhận id 102 (không phải 3, và không đụng nhau về sau).

ticket (id int GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PK, title) — id 1, 2 đã dùng

Yêu cầu

  • INSERT … OVERRIDING SYSTEM VALUE VALUES (100, …), (101, …) — cột GENERATED ALWAYS từ chối id ghi tay nếu không có nó.
  • Dời sequence của cột identity: SELECT setval(pg_get_serial_sequence('ticket', 'id'), …) tính từ bảng, không ghi cứng 101.

setval(seq, n) makes the next value n + 1; take n from max(id).|||setval(seq, n) làm giá trị kế tiếp là n + 1; lấy n từ max(id).

exercises.title: VAT on an invoice, rounded like an accountant
exercises.problemHtml:
Print the invoice of order 5: for each line return sku, qty, unit_price, line_total (qty × unit_price), vat = 8 % of line_total rounded to whole đồng, and avg_unit = the average unit price of the order's lines rounded to 2 decimals (same value on each line). Order by sku.

Sample database: CT Shop mini (the course's lab project, sliced)

customer       (id PK, email UNIQUE lower-case, full_name, phone NULL, city DEFAULT 'Hà Nội', created_at timestamptz)
category       (id PK, name UNIQUE, parent_id → category.id — NULL = root)       12 rows: 1–4 roots, 5–12 children
product        (id PK, sku UNIQUE, name, category_id → category, price numeric(12,2) > 0, stock int ≥ 0 DEFAULT 0,
                attrs jsonb DEFAULT '{}', is_active boolean DEFAULT true, created_at)          16 rows (ids 1…46, gaps)
orders         (id PK, customer_id → customer, status pending|paid|shipped|cancelled, created_at timestamptz, note)   14 rows
order_item     (order_id → orders ON DELETE CASCADE, product_id → product, qty > 0, unit_price) — PK (order_id, product_id)
payment        (id PK, order_id UNIQUE → orders, amount, method cod|card|momo|bank, paid_at)    one per paid/shipped order
stock_movement (id PK, product_id → product, change ≠ 0, reason import|sale|return|adjust, order_id NULL, created_at)
review         (id PK, product_id → product, customer_id → customer, rating 1–5, body, created_at) — UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)

Same 8 tables as Labs 1–9 (in schema public instead of shop); the rows are a small slice of the lab data — same category tree, same product ids/SKUs/prices. Every id is GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY: leave it out of INSERT. Times are timestamptz shown in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. Full script: the ctshop.sql tab.

Requirements

  • Join order_item to product for the sku; filter order 5.
  • vat = round(line_total * 0.08); avg_unit from a subquery (or a window function) on the same order.

-- Plain PostgreSQL: run it as-is in psql to get the same database on your machine.
SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);

SELECT p.sku,
       oi.qty,
       oi.unit_price,
       oi.qty * oi.unit_price                    AS line_total,
       round(oi.qty * oi.unit_price * 0.08)      AS vat,          -- numeric × numeric: exact, then round
       (SELECT round(avg(unit_price), 2)
        FROM order_item WHERE order_id = 5)       AS avg_unit
FROM order_item oi
JOIN product p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE oi.order_id = 5
ORDER BY p.sku;

  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);
